ratings.reason: Fits linear directions separating harmful from benign prompts at the audio-to-LM interface and residual layers, then causally ablates them to localize the refusal margin (e.g. -7.10 margin change at Qwen2.5-Omni L16 vs -0.013 at the projector, with backbone-fitted directions transferring to the full audio model) — classic direction-fitting plus causal intervention in the mechanistic-interpretability tradition, extending it to audio LMs.

Peerify decomposes peer-review comments into atomic claims, retrieves manuscript evidence, and verifies support on an 800-claim NeurIPS/ICLR 2024 benchmark (automated labels agree 90.3% with human consensus while entailment baselines stay below 0.24 macro-F1) — an automated-reviewing component of the AI-scientist toolchain, though the pipeline itself runs no autonomous research loop.

AIBuildAI-2.5 is an autonomous agent that builds AI models end-to-end via LLM-guided tree search with a judge scoring expected improvement/grounding/feasibility, a resource-aware training scheduler, and a cost-tiered LLM router, ranking first on MLE-Bench (73.3% medal rate) and beating baselines on six AIRS-Bench autonomous-research tasks — directly targets the core problem of autonomous AI research/engineering agents.

FrontierMath Erdős is a controlled benchmark of 68 still-open Erdős problems that AI systems must autonomously resolve (prove or disprove) in the Lean proof assistant under an equal $300/problem budget, where the best of five AIs scored 3% — a systematic instrument for measuring frontier progress toward automated mathematical discovery.

Studies error dynamics when an agent writes conclusions into its own append-only memory store and retrieves from it, introducing a parameter-free copy function gamma(phi) that predicts drift direction on 353/360 real-fact runs and a consistency-gate intervention driving capture to 0.993 — a direct measurement of reliability and error accumulation in long-running self-writing agent loops.

CoVeR routes verifier calls in agentic retrieval through a single threshold on a frozen sentence-embedding coverage margin, cutting 62-68% of verifier calls (93% in saturated regimes) while matching full-budget answer accuracy across three multi-hop QA benchmarks — preserves the trustworthiness of agent stopping decisions, but its primary contribution is a cost-reduction gate rather than advancing the self-evolving-agent problem itself.
